tools.description: A shared list as data: title, unit, dates, trail, totals in grams, and every folder with its rows (brand, name, variant, quantity, weight of one unit in grams, classification, note, calories, who carries it; a nested row without carried_by is carried by its parent's carrier). tools.name: get_list_markdown
tools.description: The same list as Markdown: one table per folder and a totals block, the text the site's own Markdown export produces. Takes a share code or share link. tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Fuzzy search of Mahonia's cited gear catalog by brand, product or kind of gear ("duplex", "zpacks", "quilt"). Each result carries a catalog id, the cited weight in grams and whether it is verified. Use get_catalog_product for every variant of one product.

tools.name: get_catalog_product
tools.description: One product's variants (sizes, lengths, temperature ratings) with the cited weight and source of each. Give a catalog id from search_catalog, or the brand and product name.

tools.name: create_list
tools.description: Creates a list and returns its edit link and share link. Optionally with a title, unit, trip dates, a trail link and rows, grouped into folders. Keep the edit link: it is the only way back into the list.

tools.name: add_items
tools.description: Adds rows to an existing list. Takes the list's edit link and the rows; each row may name a folder, and a folder that doesn't exist yet is created.

tools.name: set_trip
tools.description: Sets any of a list's title, display unit, trip dates and trail on an existing list. Only the fields given change; an empty string clears a date or the trail. Takes the list's edit link.
